headline: Ordinance Committee to discuss scheduling timing for appeal hearings on BCO Sec. 21-45A(F)(3) Trespass on City Property.
summary: The committee will take public comment and discuss scheduling timing for appeal hearings related to trespass on city property under BCO Sec. 21-45A(F)(3). Other committee business may also be raised.
